summary: Sandbox execution by default passed QA review. Docker auto-detection now enables containers by default.

checks.name: Docker availability detection
checks.details: dockerAvailable() uses execFileSync('docker', ['info']) with 2s timeout. Result cached per process lifetime.

checks.name: Default config auto-detection
checks.details: readContainerConfig() reads existing container.json, falls through to dockerAvailable() when no config exists. Existing opt-outs respected.

checks.name: isDockerAvailable server action
checks.details: New server action available for frontend to query Docker status.

checks.name: getContainerConfig returns docker status
checks.details: Response now includes dockerAvailable boolean alongside enabled flag.

checks.name: Graceful fallback
checks.details: When Docker is unavailable, containers default to disabled. No crashing or hanging.

checks.name: Consistent with existing code
checks.details: Uses execFileSync consistent with getState(). Removed unused DEFAULT constant. Removed stale eslint-disable directive.
